rows.grounds: locative compound indicating location; gulpa (ankle) + madhya (middle)
compound naming the designated thread; śiva + sūtra

items.question: What thread situated in the middle of the ankle is designated as the śivasūtra?
premises: A thread is situated in the middle of the ankle.
That situated thread is designated as the śivasūtra.
This designation is transmitted as traditionally remembered.
items.inference: The thread located at the middle of the ankle is identified as the śivasūtra.
items.plain_english: The thread situated in the middle of the ankle is remembered as the śivasūtra.
